name: nextroom
description: Google Calendar linked Google Meet launcher for macOS.

scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.release:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish always -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.lint: pnpm exec oxlint . && pnpm run lint:arrows
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec oxlint . --fix && pnpm exec biome check --write .
scripts.ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run build
scripts.check: pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm exec oxlint . && pnpm run lint:arrows && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: NextRoom needs camera access for Google Meet calls.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NextRoom needs microphone access for Google Meet calls.
